faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Panjab University Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Panjab University Guest Faculty recruitment is 02 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an MCA/M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, or Computer Applications, or an M.Tech or allied subject with at least 55% marks. Additionally, NET/SLET/SET qualification or a Ph.D. degree as per UGC regulations 2018 is required.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Guest Faculty position in Panjab University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty post is Rs. 1500/- per lecture, with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Panjab University, which is https://puchd.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I attach with the application form?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Panjab University?
faq.answer: The official website of Panjab University is https://puchd.ac.in. You can find more information and the application form here.
